summary: Lipocine Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on September 10, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing that management will present and meet with investors at the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference, held September 14-16, 2026, in New York City, with the presentation scheduled for September 16 at 10am ET. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural terms are disclosed. This is an ordinary investor-conference announcement, not a special situation; no deal terms apply.
